description: Shared animation state machine. Every one of the twelve cinematic chess pieces implements these states; per-piece-type overrides only extend, never replace, the contract.

Bishop.notes: Crosier staff sweeps on capture; mitre stays level during glide.

King.notes: Slowest glide; scepter-blade raised on check declaration.

Knight.notes: Centaur body uses quadruped locomotion; rears on capture strike.

Pawn.notes: Shortest glide distance; kneels on promotion square.

Queen.notes: War-fan blades unfold during combat pose.

Rook.notes: Castle staff plants on move end; shockwave ring on capture.

ArmorMovement.description: Subtle armor plate shift layered over idle — sells the weight of plate.

CapeMovement.description: Cloth simulation for faction capes; reacts to glide velocity and wind.

CaptureStrike.description: One-shot attack animation on capture; piece-specific.

CombatPose.description: Threat display held briefly after a capture or when giving check.

Defeated.description: Falls and fades on capture; armor clatters, cape settles.

IdleBreathing.description: Default board presence: breathing, blinking, faint glow pulse.

MoveGlide.description: Glide-move to the target square — the signature chess-piece locomotion.

WeaponIdle.description: Weapon rest pose; staff planted, blade lowered, fans folded.
